site_subtitle: St. Mina Coptic Orthodox Church • Calgary, AB

hymns.title: Conclusion of the Orthodox Creed (Matins/Vespers - Long)

texts.en: We look for the resurrection of the dead, and the life of the age to come. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁ ⲧ̀ϩⲏ ⲛ̀ϯⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ. Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ten gosht evol kha et hee-enti anastasis, ente-ni refmoo-oot, nem pi-onkh ente pi-eoo-oon ethneeyou. Amen.

texts.en: Through the intercessions, of the Theotokos Saint Mary, O Lord grant us, the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni presvia / Ente ti Theotokos Ethowab Maria / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through the intercessions of the holy archangel Michael the head of the heavenly: O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲓⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀. Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni presvia / ente piarchee angelos ethowab / Mikhail eparkhon en-na-nifiowi / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through the intercessions of the seven archangels, and the heavenly orders, O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓϣⲁϣϥ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲧⲁⲅⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni presvia / ente pi shashf en archee angelos / nem ni tagma en eporanion / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through the prayers of my lords and fathers, the apostles, and the rest of the disciples, O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲁⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲥⲉⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ: Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni evki ente / Na choice enyoti / en apostolos nem ep sepi / ente ni Mathitis / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through the prayers: of the blessed Archdeacon: Stephen the first martyr: O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲇⲓⲁⲕⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲧⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ: Ⲥ̀ⲧⲉⲫⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲡⲓϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni evki ente / pi-archee-ziakon etesmaroot / e-Stefanos pishorp em-martiros / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through the prayers of the Beholder of God, the Evangelist Mark, the apostle, O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲑⲉⲱ̀ⲣⲓⲙⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲩⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni evki ente / Pithorimos en evangilistees / Markos pi apostolos / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through the prayers of the struggle-mantled martyrs, my lord Prince George, Theodorus the general, Philopater Mercurius, Abba Mena of Vayat: O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ: ⲡⲁⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲅⲉⲱ̀ⲣⲅⲓⲟⲥ, Ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲇⲱⲣⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲧ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲓⲗⲁⲧⲏⲥ, Ⲫⲓⲗⲟⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ Ⲙⲉⲣⲕⲟⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ, ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲪⲁⲓⲁⲧ: Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni evki ente / niathloforos em Martiros / Pachoice ep ooro Gawargios / Theodoros pi-estratilatees / Philopateer Merkorios / Avva Mina enteny Vayat / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through the prayers of the brides of Christ Saints Barbara and Juliana and Demiana and Marina and Irene and Anasimon and Aripsima and Anastasia: O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭ︦ⲥ︦ ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ Ⲃⲁⲣⲃⲁⲣⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲓⲟⲗⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲇⲩⲙⲓⲁⲛⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲛⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲓ̀ⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲛⲁⲥⲓⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲣⲯ̀ⲓⲙⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲁ: Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni evki ente / nishelet ente pi-khristos tagia emm-eei / Barbara nem Yolianee, nem Dimianee, nem Marin-ee, nem Eree-nee, nem Anasimon, nem Aripsima, nem Anastasia / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through the prayers of the saints of this day, each one according to their names, O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲁⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ: ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ: Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni evki ente / Ni ethowab ente Pai eho-oo / Pi owai Pi owai Kata pefran / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through their prayers, keep the life of our honored father, the archpriest, Pope Abba (...). O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲏ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲱⲓⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ: ⲡⲁⲡⲁ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten no evki areh / Ep onkhen peniot / Etayot enarashee erevs / Baba Avva (...) / Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: Through their prayers, keep the life of our honored and righteous father, Abba (...) the bishop (metropolitan), O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ (ⲡⲓⲙⲏⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲓⲧⲏⲥ): Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten no evki areh / Ep onkhen peniot / Etayot enzikeos / Avva (...) / Piepiskopos (pi-metropolitis), Epchoice ari ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen novi.

texts.en: We worship You, O Christ, with Your good Father, and the Holy Spirit, for You have come and saved us. Have mercy on us.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲓ̀ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ten Oosht emmok o pi Ekhristos / Nem pek yout en Agathos / Nem pi epnevma ethowab / Je akee ak soti emmon nai nan

texts.en: Saved. Amen. And with your spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲱⲑⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲥⲟⲩ
texts.cop_en: Sotees Amen. Ke to epnevmati so.

texts.en: Amen. Amen. Amen. Your Death, O Lord, we proclaim; Your holy Resurrection and Ascension into the heavens, we confess.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: ⲧⲟⲛ ⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲛ ⲥⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲕⲁⲧⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲗⲟⲙⲉⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲧⲏⲛ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁⲛ ⲥⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲏⲛ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲗⲏⲯⲓⲛ ⲥⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲏⲥ ⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲥ ⲥⲉ ⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲗⲟⲅⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Amin, Amin, Amin, Ton thana ton sou kirie katangelomen. Ke tin agian sou anastaseen Ke tin analin epseen sou entees ouranees se omologhomen.

texts.en: We praise You, we bless You, we thank You, O Lord, and we entreat You, O our God.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲉ ⲉ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛ ⲥⲉ ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛ ⲥⲓ ⲉⲩⲭⲁⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ: ⲕⲉ ⲇⲉⲟ̀ⲙⲉⲑⲁ ⲥⲟⲩ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Se enoumen se evloghoumen si evharistoumen kirie, ke zeometa sou o Theos emon.

texts.en: We praise You, we bless You, we serve You, we worship You.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ ⲧⲉⲛⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ ⲧⲉⲛϣⲉⲙϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ.
texts.cop_en: Tenhos erok tenesmo erok tenshemshi emmok teno-oosht emmok.

texts.en: Have mercy upon us, O God, our Saviour. (x3)
texts.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ Ⲟ̀ ⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ. (x3)
texts.cop_en: Eleyson eemas O theos O Coteer ee-mon. (x3)

texts.en: Have mercy upon us, O God, our Saviour. (x3)
texts.cop: ϫⲉ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ̀ⲫⲛⲟⲩⲧⲓ ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ. (x3)
texts.cop_en: Je nai nan, efnouti Pensouteer (x3)

texts.en: Amen. We believe, we confess, and we glorify.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲡⲓⲥⲧⲉⲩⲟ̀ⲙⲉⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲗⲟⲅⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲇⲟⲝⲁⲍⲟⲙⲉⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Amen. Pistevomen ke omologhomen ke zoxazomen.

texts.en: Amen. Again, we believe, we confess, and we glorify.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲡⲓⲥⲧⲉⲩⲟ̀ⲙⲉⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲗⲟⲅⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲇⲟⲝⲁⲍⲟⲙⲉⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Amen. Ke palin Pistevomen ke omologhomen ke zoxazomen.

texts.en: May their holy blessing be with us. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ. Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ere poo esmoo ethowab Shopi neman Amin.

texts.en: Glory to You, O Lord. Lord have mercy. Lord have mercy. Lord, bless us. Lord, repose them. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲏⲥⲟⲛ: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲡⲁⲩⲥⲟⲛ: ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: zoxa si Kirie zoxa si Kirie Kirie Eleyson Kirie Eleyson Kirie evlogison Kirie anapavson Amin.

hymns.title: Verses of the Cymbals (Watos Intro - English)

texts.en: Lord have mercy.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Kerie eleyson.

texts.en: We worship the Father and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the holy and co-essential Trinity.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ Ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: Ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲛ̀ⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲟⲩⲥⲓⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Ten oo osht em Efiot nem epshiri: Nem Pi epnevma Ethowab: Ti Etrias Ethowab: En omo oosios.

texts.en: Hail to the Church, the house of the angels, hail to the Virgin, who gave birth to our Savior.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ϯⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲉⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ.
texts.cop_en: Shere ti ekkliseia: Epee ente ni angelos: Shere ti parthenos: Etasmes Pensoteer.

hymns.title: Psali Watos for the three Saintly Children (English)

texts.en: O sing unto Him who was crucified, buried and resurrected for us, and trampled and abolished death, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲁϣϥ: ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲕⲟⲥϥ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲁϥⲕⲱⲣϥ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲁϥϯϣⲟϣϥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Aripsalin efe-etav ashf, e-ehri egon owoh avkosf, aftonf afkorf emef-mo afti shoshf, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Take off the old man, and put on the new and superior one, come closer to the greatness of mercy, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲃⲱϣ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲗⲉⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϫⲱⲗϩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲃⲉⲣⲓ ⲉⲩⲕ̀ⲗⲉⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉ̀ϧⲱⲛⲧ ⲉ̀ⲙⲉⲅⲁⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲟⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Vosh empi-romi empali-os, owoh golh empi-veri evek-leos, owoh ekhon emgha-elos, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: All you Christian people, the priests and the deacons, glorify the Lord for He is worthy, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀Ⲛⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲓⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲇⲓⲁⲕⲟⲛⲟⲥ: ⲙⲁⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩϩⲓⲕⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Genos enikh-resteyanos, ni-epres-veteros ke zeia-konos, ma-o-oo emip-shois je ohi-kanos, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Come to us O three children, whom Christ our God has lifted, and from the devil has delivered, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲇⲉⲩⲧⲉ ϩⲁⲣⲟⲛ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓϣⲟⲙⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲟⲩ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲟ̀ⲗⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲛⲁϩⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁ Ⲡⲓⲇⲓⲁⲃⲟⲗⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Zevte haron o-pi-shomt en-alo, eta Pekhrestos pennouti olo, af-nahmo evol hapi-zeiav-lo, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: For the sake of your God the Messiah, the giver of all good things, come unto us O Hananiah, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ Ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲙⲁⲥⲓⲁⲥ: Ⲫ̀ⲣⲉϥϯ ⲛ̀ⲉⲩⲉⲣⲅⲉⲥⲓⲁⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ϣⲁⲣⲟⲛ Ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲛⲓⲁⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Ethve peknouti Maseias, ef-refti enev-erge-seias, a-mo sharon Ana-neias, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: O Azariah the zealot, evening and morning and at noon, glorify the power of the Trinity, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲍⲏⲗⲱⲧⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲍⲁⲣⲓⲁⲥ: ⲉⲥⲡⲉⲣⲁⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲡ̀ⲣⲱⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲙⲉⲥⲏⲙ ⲃ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ: ⲙⲁⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ϫⲟⲙ ⲛ̀Ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Zelote Azareias, esperas ke epro-e ke miss-mev-reias, ma-o-oo enet-gom in-Tit-reias, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Behold Immanuel, is now in our midst O Mishael, proclaim with the voice of joy, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲏⲡⲡⲉ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲓⲥ Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: ϩⲓ ⲧⲉⲛⲙⲏϯ ⲱ̀ Ⲙⲓⲥⲁⲏⲗ: ⲗⲁⲗⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Eppe ghar yes Emmanoueel, he ten-me-ti o Mesaeel, lali khen o-esme en-theleel, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Gather now and persevere, and proclaim with the priests, bless the Lord all His works, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲑⲱⲟⲩϯ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲭⲓⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲩ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲉϥϩ̀ⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Tho-ooti tino kate shin teroo, saji nemni-epres-ve-tero, esmo Epshois nef-ehve-owee teroo, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: The heavens declare the glory, of God until this day, O you angels whom He has made, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲓⲥ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲥⲉⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲫⲟⲟⲩ: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫ̀ⲫⲱⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Yes nefee-owe se-saji emip-o-oo, Emif-nouti sha ekhon em-fo-oo, o ni-angelos etaf-egfo-oo, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Now all you powers of the Lord, bless His honored name, O sun and moon and all the stars, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲇⲩⲛⲁⲙⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲩ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲧⲓⲙⲓⲟⲩ: ⲡⲓⲣⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲓⲟϩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Ke nin zenamis too Kereie, esmo epif-ran to ti-meio, piree nem peyoh nem ni-seio, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: And also O you rain and dew, sing praises unto our Savior, for He is God of our fathers, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲗⲟⲓⲡⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲟⲩⲛ̀ϩⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲓⲱϯ: ⲉⲩⲫⲏⲙⲓⲥⲁ ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛⲣⲉϥⲥⲱϯ: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲡⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Leboon ni-monho-oo nem nei-yoti, ev-fi-misa te penref-souti, je enthof pe Efnouti ente nen-yoti, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Glorify the Lord O clouds and winds, together with the souls and the spirits, O you cold and fire and heat, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲙⲁⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲱ̀ ⲛⲓϭⲏⲡⲓ ⲉⲩⲙⲁ: ⲛⲓⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲛⲓϥⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ: ⲡⲓϫⲁϥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲕⲁⲩⲙⲁ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Ma-oo Emip-shois o ni-etshepi evma, ni-theio nem ni-nifi nem ni-epnev-ma, pi-gaf nem pek-rom nem pi-kavma, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Also nights and days: light, darkness and lightning say: "Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind," Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲛⲩⲕⲧⲉⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲏ̀ⲙⲉⲣⲉⲣⲱ ⲡⲉ: ⲫⲱⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲥ̀ⲕⲟⲧⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲁⲥⲧ̀ⲣⲁⲡⲉ: ϫⲉ ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ Ⲫⲓⲗⲁⲛⲑ̀ⲣⲱⲡⲉ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Nektes ke emre-rope, fos ke es-kotos ke asit-rape, je zoxa see filan-ethrope, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: You trees and all that springs on the earth, and all that moves in the waters, mountains and the forests, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲝⲩⲗⲁ ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲛⲧⲁ ⲧⲁ ⲫⲩⲟ̀ⲙⲉⲛⲁ: ⲉⲛ ⲧⲏ ⲅⲏ ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲛⲧⲁ ⲧⲁ ⲕⲓⲛⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲁ: ϩⲓ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲇ̀ⲣⲩⲙⲟⲛⲁ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Exela ke panta ta fi-omina, en ti-ge ke panta ta ki-no-mina, he ni-mo-oo nem ni-to-oo nem ezri-mona, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Praise without ceasing, the Lord the King of the Kings, O you rivers and seas, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲛ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲭⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲓⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Owoh on esmo an-atkaro-oo, Epshois ep-Oroo ente ni-ero-oo, ni-a-maio nem ni-aro-oo, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: And we also seeing them, let us say with all these things, bless the Lord all you birds, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛϫⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲱⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲓϩⲁⲗⲁϯ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Pai-reti anon ten-nav ero-o, maren-gos nem nai on teroo, esmo Epshois ni-halati teroo, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: O snow and ice, cattle and wild beasts, bless the Lord of lords, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲣⲱ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲁⲭⲛⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲭⲓⲱⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲕ̀ⲧⲏⲛⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲑⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲱⲛ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Ro enni-pakhni nem ni-sheion, ke ekti-non nem ni-thereion, esmo Epshois ton ke-reion, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Bless the Lord as befits Him, and not like the disobedient, all you sons of men, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲧⲱⲙⲓ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲕⲉ ⲟⲩ ⲙⲏ ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲛⲟⲙⲓ: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲓϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo Epshois kata ef-tomi, erof ke o-me para-nomee, o ni-shere ente ni-roumi, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: O Israel offer before Him, honor and glory in a joyful voice, all you priests of Immanuel, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲓⲙⲏ ⲕⲉ ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ: ⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲁϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Ti-me ke zoxa o pis-rael, eni nah-raf khen o-esmi en-theleel, ni-oweb ente Emmanoueel, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: You servants of the true God, the souls of the righteous, and the humble and the charitable, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲩ̀ⲡⲏⲣⲉⲧⲱⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲑ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲑⲉⲃⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥⲙⲉⲓ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Ee-per-ton Emif-nouti emme, nem ni-epsi-shi ente ni-ethme, ni-et-thevio enref-me, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: God my God is the one, who saved you from danger, O Shadrach Meshach and Abed-Nego, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲉ̀ⲅⲱ: Ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲛⲣⲉϥⲥⲱϯ ⲉⲕ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲁ̀ⲅⲱ: Ⲥⲉⲇⲣⲁⲕ Ⲙⲓⲥⲁⲕ Ⲁⲃⲇⲉⲛⲁⲅⲱ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Efnouti panouti ego, peten-ref-souti ekton ago, Cedrak Misak Abde-nagi, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Hurry with great watchfulness, O you righteous of the Lord, and all the creatures He has made, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲱⲗⲉⲙ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ϣ̀ⲣⲱⲓⲥ: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲉⲣⲥⲉⲃⲉⲥⲑⲉ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲫⲩⲥⲓⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲁⲓⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Kolem khen oo-nishti e-nesh-rois, o ni-et-er-sebeste Emipshois, nem ni-fee-sis teroo etaf-ais, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: Coolness and repose without ceasing, grant unto all of us, that we may joyfully proclaim, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲯⲩⲭⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲡⲁⲩⲥⲓⲥ: ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ ⲭⲱⲣⲓⲥ ⲑ̀ⲣⲁⲩⲥⲓⲥ: ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲛϫⲱ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲁⲩⲥⲓⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: Epsi-khos ke ana pav-sees, moi nan ti-ren khores ethrav-sees, ethren-go khen oo-apolo-lav-sees, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

texts.en: And also Your poor servant Sarkis, make him without condemnation, that he may join all those and say, Praise Him and exalt Him above all.
texts.cop: Ⲱ̀ⲥⲁⲩⲧⲱⲥ ⲡⲉⲕⲃⲱⲕ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲧⲱⲭⲟⲥ: Ⲥⲁⲣⲕⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲧϥ ⲉϥⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲉⲛⲟⲭⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲁⲓ ϩⲱⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲟⲭⲟⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.
texts.cop_en: O-savtos pek-vok pi-epto-khos, Sarkis aritf efoi ennen-khos, e-saji nem nai hos meto-khos, hos erof areh ho-oo chasf.

hymns.title: The Vespers Doxology for the Virgin (English)

texts.en: The Adornment of Mary / in the highest heaven / at the right hand of her beloved / entreating Him on our behalf.
texts.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ⲥⲟⲗⲥⲉⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲧ̀ⲥⲁ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ: ⲉ̀ⲥⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ere epsol sel em Mariam/ khen ni fi ouwi etsa epshoi/ sa ouwi nam em pes men rit/ estovh emmof eh ehri egon

texts.en: As David has said / in the Book of Psalms, / “The Queen stood at / Your right hand,” O King.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲯ̀ⲁⲗⲟⲙⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ: ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲡ̀Ⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
texts.cop_en: Kata efriti etaf gos/ enje Davide khen pi epsalmos/ je us ohowi erats inje ti ourow/ sa ouwi nam emmok eporo

texts.en: Solomon has called her / in the Song of Songs, / “My sister and my spouse / my true city Jerusalem.”
texts.cop: Ⲥⲟⲗⲟⲙⲱⲛ ⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲣⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓϫⲱ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϫⲱ: ϫⲉ ⲧⲁⲥⲱⲛⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲁϣ̀ⲫⲉⲣⲓ: ⲧⲁⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ Ⲓⲉⲣⲟⲩⲥⲁⲗⲏⲙ.
texts.cop_en: Solomon motee eros / khen pigo ente nigo / je tasoni owoh ta ehveeri / tapolis emee Yaroosalim.

texts.en: For he has given a symbol of her / in many high names, saying / “Come out of your garden, / O choicest aroma.”
texts.cop: Ⲁϥϯⲙⲏⲓⲛⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲉⲩϭⲟⲥⲓ: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲏ̀ⲡⲟⲥ: ⲱ̀ ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲁⲧⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Afteemini ghar eros / khen hanmeesh enran ev-echosy / je amee evol khen pek-ee-pos / 0 thee etasotp en aromata

texts.en: Hail to you, O Virgin, / the right and true Queen. / Hail to the pride of our race / who bore to us Immanuel.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲠⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Shere ne o teeparthenos / tee-oro emee enaleethini / shere epsho- sho ente pengenos / ariegvo nan en-Emanoeel

texts.en: We ask you to remember us, / O our faithful advocate, / before our Lord Jesus Christ / that He may forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Tenteeho aripamevi / O tee- eprostasis entenhot / naren Penchois Isos Pekhristos / entef kha nenovi nan evol.

texts.en: What will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world and loses his soul? O the futility of this life!
texts.cop: Ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ: ϫⲉⲙϩⲏⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϯⲟ̀ⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ: ⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲁⲓ ⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲗⲏⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Eshop on ente niromi, jemheeyo empikosmos teerf, entef-tee-osi entef-epsikee, o pe pai onkh enefleyoo.

texts.en: The saint Abba Mina, heard the divine voice, and forsook the whole world, and its corrupt glory.
texts.cop: Ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲡⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ: ⲁϥⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ϯⲥⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲁϥⲭⲱ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲧⲁⲕⲟ.
texts.cop_en: Pi-agios apa Mina, afsotem enca tee-smee en-nootee, afko empikosmos teerf ensof, nem pefoo-o ethnatako.

texts.en: He gave his soul up to death, and his flesh to the fire, and accepted great torment, For the Son of the living God.
texts.cop: Ⲁϥϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ⲫⲙⲟⲩ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ: ⲁϥϣⲉⲡ ϩⲁⲛⲛⲓϣϯ ⲙ̀ⲃⲁⲥⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉⲑⲃⲉ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ.
texts.cop_en: Aftee entef-pski e-efmo, nem pefsoma epiekrom, afshep hannishtee emvasanos, ethve epshiri emefnouti etonkh.

texts.en: Therefore, our Savior / lifted him up to His kingdom, / and granted him the good things / that no eye has seen.
texts.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲁ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲤⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ⲟⲗϥ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ⲁϥϯⲛⲁϥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲃⲁⲗ ⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Ethve fai a-pensoteer, olf ekhon etefmetoro, aftee-naf en-niaghathon, enee-te empeval nav eroo-o.

texts.en: Hail to you, O martyr: Hail to the noble hero: Hail to the struggle- mantled: Saint Abba Mina.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϣⲱⲓϫ ⲛ̀ⲅⲉⲛⲛⲉⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲡⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Shere nak O pi-marteros, shere pi-shoig en-genneos, shere pi-athloforos, avva Mina ente ni-Vaiat.

texts.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf: O struggle- mantled martyr: Saint Abba Mina: that He may forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲡⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Tobh emepchoise e-ehri egon, O piathloforos em-marteros, piagios apa Mina, entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

texts.en: Hail to you O martyr, Hail to the courageous hero, Hail to the struggle-mantled, Abba Mina of Bayat.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ̀ⲱⲡⲓⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϣⲱⲓϫ ⲛ̀ⲅⲉⲛⲛⲉⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ: ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲛⲓⲫⲁⲓⲁⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Shere nak O pi-marteros, shere pi-shoig en-genneos, shere pi-athloforos, avva Mina ente ni-Vaiat.

texts.en: Glory to You O Lord, glory to You.
texts.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Zoxa ci kirie. Zoxa ci.

texts.en: Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia

texts.en: Praise God in all His saints.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo Efnouti khen ni-ethowab tiro entaf, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him in the firmament of His power.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen pi-tagro ente tef-gom, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him for His mighty acts.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧϫⲱⲣⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof e-ehri hijen tefmet-gowri, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him according to the multitudes of His greatness.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲁ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧⲛⲓϣϯ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof kata ep-ashai ente tef-met-nishti, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲅⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen ou-esmi ensalpen-ghos, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with psaltery and harp.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲯⲁⲗⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen ou-epsal-terion nem ou-kithara, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with timbrel and chorus.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen han-kem-kem nem han-khoros, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with strings and organs.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲁⲡ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲟⲣⲅⲁⲛⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen han-kap nem ou-orghanon, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with pleasant sounding cymbals.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲉ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen han-kim-valon ene-setou-esmi, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him upon the cymbals of joy.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲉ̀ϣ̀ⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓ̀.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen han-valon ente ou-eshlilowi, alleluia.

texts.en: Let every thing that has breath praise the name of the Lord our God.
texts.cop: Ⲛⲓϥⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ.
texts.cop_en: Nifi niven maro-esmo tiro Ee-efran Emipshois Pennouti, alleluia.

texts.en: Glory to the Father, and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ̀ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Zoxa Patree ke Eio ke Agio Epnevmati, alleluia.

texts.en: Now and ever and unto the ages of the ages. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ke neen ke a-ee ke estos e-onas ton e-onon amen. Alleluia.

texts.en: Alleluia, Alleluia, glory to you our God.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅: ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ ⲟ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia, alleluia, Zoxa si o Theos emon, alleluia.

texts.en: Alleluia, Alleluia, glory be to our God.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅: ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ ⲡⲉⲛⲚⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia, alleluia, pi-ow-ou fa pennouti pe, alleluia.

texts.en: O Jesus Christ, the Son of God, hear us and have mercy upon us.
texts.cop: Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Esos Pi-khristos epshiri emefnouti, sotem eron owoh nai nan.

texts.en: In the name of the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the Holy and co-essential Trinity.
texts.cop: Ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲟⲩⲥⲓⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Khen efran emif-noti nem ep-she-ree nem pi-epnevma eth-owab tit-reias eth-owab en-omo-seios.

texts.en: Worthy, worthy, worthy, is St. Mary the Virgin.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲝⲓⲁ ⲁⲝⲓⲁ ⲁⲝⲓⲁ ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ̀ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Axia, axia, axia, ti-ageia Maria ti-pa-arthenos.

texts.en: Worthy, worthy, worthy (...).

texts.en: We send you greetings / with Gabriel the angel, / saying, “Hail to you, O full of grace, / the Lord is with you.”
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯ ⲛⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲉⲣⲉⲧⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲕⲉⲭⲁⲣⲓⲧⲱⲙⲉⲛⲏ: ⲟ̀ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁ ⲥⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Tenti nem-pi-shere tis-mos, nem Ghabriel pi-angelos, je shere ke kharito-mini, o Kerios metaso.

texts.en: Therefore we glorify you, as the Mother of God at all times. Ask the Lord on our behalf, that He may forgive us our sins!
texts.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉ: ϩⲱⲥ Ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ⲙⲁϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Ethve fai ten-ti o-oo-ne, hos theo-tokos enseio nivin, matiho e-epshois e-ehrey e-gon, entef ka nen-novi nan e-vol.

texts.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son / and the Holy Spirit / the perfect Trinity / we worship Him and glorify Him.
texts.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟ̀ⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϯⲦ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲧⲉⲛⲟ̀ⲩⲱ̀ϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟ̀ⲩ ⲛⲁⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Jefes maroout / En jefyot nem Epshiri / Nem pi Epnevma Ethowab / Tietrias etjeek evol / Ten Oosht Emmos Tentiou Nas

texts.en: We exalt you worthily, / with Elizabeth your cousin: / saying, “Blessed are you among women, / blessed is the fruit of your womb.”
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲉⲙⲡ̀ϣⲁ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲉ̀ⲗⲓⲥⲁⲃⲉⲧ ⲧⲉⲥⲩⲅⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ: ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲧⲁϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉⲛⲉϫⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Tenit-shesi emmo khen o-emipsha, nem elee-sabet te-sen-genis, je tis-maroot entho khenni-heyomi, efis-maroot enje ep-otah ente-te-neje.

texts.en: Therefore we glorify you, as the Mother of God at all times. Ask the Lord on our behalf, that He may forgive us our sins!
texts.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉ: ϩⲱⲥ Ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ⲙⲁϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.

texts.en: The virginal birth and spiritual pangs - a paradoxical wonder, according to the prophetic voices!
texts.cop: Ⲡⲓϫⲓⲛⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲓⲕⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓⲛⲁⲕϩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲟⲝⲟⲛ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Pijen-misi emparse-nikon owoh ni-nak-he, emep-nevma-tikon o eshfe-ree empara-zoxon kata ni esmee emep-rofee-teekon.

texts.en: Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name, Thy kingdom come, for Thine is the glory forever.
texts.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟ̀ⲩⲓ̀: ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟ̀ⲩⲣⲟ: ϫⲉ ⲫⲱⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟ̀ⲩ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

texts.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the perfect Trinity, we worship Him and glorify Him.

texts.en: Through the intercessions, of the trumpeter of the Resurrection, Michael the head of the heavenly, O Lord grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲯⲁⲗⲡⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ ⲛ̀Ϯⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.

texts.cop_en: Hiten ni-evki, ente ni-ethmi niromi entelios, Yosif nem Nikodeemos, nem ti-agia Maria ti-magdalene, epchoise ariehmot nan empiko evol ente nen-novi.
