texts.en: And our father the Bishop Abba (...)
texts.cop: Ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...).
texts.cop_en: nem pen yoat en-e-piskopos avva (...)

texts.en: May the clergy and all the people be safe in the Lord. Amen. So be it.
texts.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲟ̀ⲩϫⲁⲓ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲉⲥⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ.
texts.cop_en: mare pi-ek-leeros: nem pi-la-os teerf: oo-gai khen ep-choice je ameen es-e-shoapi.

texts.en: Blessed are they in truth, the saints of this day, each one according to his name, the beloved of Christ.
texts.cop: Ⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓⲁⲧⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲏⲓ: ⲛⲏⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲁⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ: ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ: ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅.
texts.cop_en: Oniato khen O methmee, ne-ethowab nte paiehoo, piowai piowai kata pefran, nimenrati nte pikhristos

texts.en: Intercede on our behalf, O lady of us all, the Mother of God, Mary, the Mother of our Savior, that He may forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉϫⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲧⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ ϯⲑⲉⲟⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲤⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Aripresvevvien eehri egoon, O tenchoise enneb teeren ti-theotokos, Maria Thmav empensoteer, ntefka nen novi nan evol

texts.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf, O struggle mantled martyr, the saint abba Mina, that He may forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉϫⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲡⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Tobh emepchoise eehri egoon, O pi-athloforos emmartiros, Piagios Avva Mina, ntefka nen novi nan evol

texts.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, the perfect Trinity. We worship Him and glorify Him.
texts.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Je efesmaroot nje eFioout nem epsheeri, nem piepnevma ethowab, tetrias etjek evol, tenoouosht emmos tentoo nas

texts.en: Alleluia. The thought of man shall confess You O Lord, and the remainder of thought shall keep a feast to You. The sacrifices and the offerings receive them to Yourself. Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ. Ϫⲉ ⲫ̀ⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ⲟ̀ⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲟ̀ⲩⲱ̀ⲛϩ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ Ⲡ̀ⲟ̅ⲥ̅: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡ̀ⲥⲱϫⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟ̀ⲩⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲉⲣϣⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲕ. Ⲛⲓⲑⲩⲥⲓⲁ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲫⲟⲣⲁ ϣⲟⲡⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ. Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia je ef-mev-ee en-oo-romi ef-e-ooonh nak evol epchois: ow-oh epsogb ente oo mevee ef-e-er-shai nak. Ni-thi-siya ni-eprosfora shopo erok. Alleluia

texts.en: This censer of pure gold bearing the aroma, is in the hands of Aaron the priest, offering up incense upon the altar.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲁⲓϣⲟⲩⲣⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲧϥⲁⲓ ϧⲁ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲁⲧⲁ: ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛϫⲓϫ ⲛ̀Ⲁ̀ⲁⲣⲱⲛ ⲡⲓⲟ̀ⲩⲏⲃ ⲉϥⲧⲁⲗⲉ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲣϣⲱⲟ̀ⲩϣⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Tay-shory ennob enka-tharos etfai kha pi-aro-mata, etkhen nen-jeeg en-A-aron pi-oweeb eftale oo-estoi-nofi e-epshoi ejen pima en-ersho-oshi.

hymns.title: Conclusion of the Orthodox Creed (Matins/Vespers - Short - Coptic)

texts.en: We look for the resurrection of the dead, and the life of the age to come. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁ ⲧ̀ϩⲏ ⲛ̀ϯⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ. Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ten gosht evol kha et hee-enti anastasis, ente-ni refmoo-oot, nem pi-onkh ente pi-eoo-oon ethneeyou. Amen.

texts.en: ... of our honored father, the archpriest, Pope Abba (...): and our father the metropolitan (bishop), Abba (...) the beloved of Christ.
texts.cop: ... ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲓⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲓⲧⲏⲥ (ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ) ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: ... Empeniot et-taiot en-arshi-erevs papa Avva (...), nem pen yoat en-e-piskopos avva (...), ni-menrati ente Pi-khrestos.

hymns.title: According to your mercy O Lord (Basilian - Coptic)

texts.en: According to Your mercy, O Lord, and not according to our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧⲟ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲟⲥ ⲥⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ: ⲕⲉ ⲙⲏ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧⲁⲥ ⲁ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲓⲁⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Kata to eleos so kerie: ke mee kata tas amerteyas emmon.

texts.en: Hail to you O Mary, the beautiful dove, who has borne to us, God the Logos.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲑⲛⲉⲥⲱⲥ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲡⲓⲖⲟⲅⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Shere ne Maria, tiche-rompi ethnesos, thee-etas-misi nan, emifnoti pi-Loghos.

texts.en: Blessed are You indeed, with Your good Father and the Holy Spirit, for You have come and saved us have mercy on us.
texts.cop: Ⲕ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲓ̀ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Eksmaro-ot alethos, nem Pekiot enagha-thos, nem pi-epnevma ethowab, je akee aksoti emmon nai nan.

hymns.title: The Matins Doxology for the Virgin (English)

texts.en: Blessed are you O Mary, the wise and the chaste, the Second tabernacle, the spiritual treasure.
texts.cop: Ⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ϯⲥⲁⲃⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲉ: ϯⲙⲁϩⲥ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ϩⲟ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Oonia-tee entho maria: tee-cavee owoh ensemnee: tee-mahesnooti eneskeenee: piaho emepnevmatikon.

texts.en: The pure turtle-dove, who declared in our land, and brought to us, the Fruit of the Spirit.
texts.cop: Ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡϣⲁⲗ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲟⲥ: ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲥⲙⲟⲩϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥⲫⲓⲣⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Tchrom-epshal enkatharos: thetasmoo-tee khen penkahi: owoh asfiri nan evol: enokarpos ente pi-epnevma.

texts.en: The Spirit of comfort, who came upon your Son, in the waters of the Jordan, according to the type of Noah.
texts.cop: ⲠⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ: ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϢⲏⲣⲓ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲒⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ⲛ̀Ⲛⲱⲉ̀.
texts.cop_en: Pi-epnevma emparakleeton: fee-etafi ejen peshiri: hijen nimoo-o ente pi-Yorzanees: kata eptee-pos en-Noe.

texts.en: That dove has, announced to us, the peace of God, for mankind.
texts.cop: Ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉⲧⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲥ ⲁⲥϩⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲛ̀ϯϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫϯ: ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Tchrompi ghar ete emmav: enthos ashi-shen-nofi nan: entee-hireenee ente efnouti: thetas-shopi sha niromi.

texts.en: Likewise you O our hope, the spiritual turtle-dove, have brought mercy unto us, carrying Him in your womb.
texts.cop: Ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ϩⲱⲓ ⲱ̀ ⲧⲉⲛϩⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ: ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡ̀ϣⲁⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲏ̀ⲧⲉ: ⲁⲣⲉⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲁⲣⲉϥⲁⲓ ϧⲁⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲉϫⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Entho hoy O tenhelpis: tchrom-epshal en-noeete: areini empi-nai nan: arefai kharof khen teneji.

texts.en: He is Jesus, the begotten of the Father, He was born of you for us, setting free our race.
texts.cop: Ⲉⲧⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅: ⲡⲓⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ: ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥϥ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϧⲏϯ: ⲁϥⲉⲣ ⲡⲉⲛϫⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉⲙϩⲉ.
texts.cop_en: Ete fai pe Esos: pimisi evolkhen efiot: avmasf nan evol enkheetee: afer pengenos enremhe.

texts.en: Therefore let us declare, first with our hearts, then also with our tongues, proclaiming and saying.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲧⲁⲟⲩⲟϥ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ϣⲟⲣⲡ: ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲱⲥ ⲟⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲕⲉⲗⲁⲥ: ⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: fai ghar marentao-oof: evolkhen penheet enshorp: menensoos on khen penkelas: enosh evol engo emmos.

texts.en: "O our Lord Jesus Christ, make for yourself within us, a temple of Your Holy Spirit, glorifying You."
texts.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲙⲁⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟ̀ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲛ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲉⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲣⲫⲉⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲠⲉⲕⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲉⲩϯⲇⲟⲝⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲁ̀ ⲛⲁⲕ.
texts.cop_en: Je penchoise Esos Pi-ekhristos: mathamioo nak ene-khri enkhee-ten: enoerfei ente pek-epnevma ethowab: evtee-zoxologia nak.

texts.en: Hail to you O Virgin, the right and true queen, hail to the pride of our race, who bore to us Emmanuel.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Shere ne O tee-parthenos: tee-oro emmeei enalee-thienee: shere epsho-sho ente pengenos: are-egfo nan emmanoeel.

texts.en: We ask you to remember us, O our faithful advocate, before our Lord Jesus Christ, that He may forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁⲣⲓⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲁⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Ten-tee-ho are-penmevi: O tee-eprostatees etenhot: nahren penchoise Esos Pi-ekhristos: entefka nen-novi nan evol.

hymns.title: Conclusion of the Hymn of Intercessions (English)

texts.en: We worship You O Christ, with Your good Father, and the Holy Spirit, for you have come and saved us. Have mercy on us.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲓ̀ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ten-o-oosht emmok O Pi-ekhristos: nem Pekioot enaghathos: nem pi-epnevma ethowab: je akee aksotee emmon nai nan.

texts.en: O give thanks to the Lord, for He is good and virtuous: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲣⲏⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲡⲉ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Ou-ownh evol Emip-shois je ou-ekhristos ou-aghathos pe Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: O give thanks to the God of gods: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Ou-ownh evol Emif-nouti ente ni-nouti, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϭⲟⲓⲥ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Ou-ownh evol Emip-shois ente ni-shois, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: To Him who alone does great wonders: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲓ̀ⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧϥ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Feiet-eeri, enhanneshti, enish-firi, emma-vatf, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: To Him who by wisdom made the heavens: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲕⲁϯ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fe-etaf thamio enni-fe-owe khen oukati, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: To Him who laid out the earth above the waters: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fe-etaf targo empi-kahi, hijen nim-ow-ou, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: To Him who made great lights: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧϥ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fe-etaf thamio enhanneshti enref erou-owini emma-vatf, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: The sun to rule by day: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫ̀ⲣⲏ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲉⲣϣⲓϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Efre e-o-ershishi, ente pi-eho-ou, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: The moon and stars to rule by night: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲡⲓⲓⲟϩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲉⲝⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϫⲱⲣϩ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Pi-ioh nem ni-seyo evik-soseya ente pi-gowrh, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: To Him who struck Egypt in their first-born: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϣⲁⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲁ Ⲭⲏⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲟⲩϣⲁⲙⲓⲥⲓ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fe-etaf shari enna kimi, nem no-shamisi, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: And brought out Israel from among them: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲟⲩⲙⲏϯ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Owoh af-eni empis-rael, evol khen toumiti, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: With a strong hand and with an outstretched arm: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩϫⲓϫ ⲉⲥⲁ̀ⲙⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϣⲱⲃϣ ⲉϥϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Khen oujig, es-amahi nem ou-showvsh, efitshosi , Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: To Him who divided the Red Sea in two: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲫⲱⲣϫ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ϣⲁⲣⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲫⲱⲣϫ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fe-etaf forg, emif-yom enshari khen han forg, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: And made Israel pass through the midst of it: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲉ̀ⲙⲏⲣ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲏϯ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Owoh af-eni empis-rael, emir khen tef-miti, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲃⲟⲣⲃⲉⲣ ⲙ̀ⲫⲁⲣⲁⲱ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ ⲧⲏⲣⲥ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ϣⲁⲣⲓ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Owoh af-vor-ver em-pharo nem tef-gom tirs e-efyom enshari, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: To Him who led His people through the wilderness: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϩⲓ ⲡ̀ϣⲁϥⲉ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fe-etaf eni empef-laos, evol enihri he epshafe, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: To Him who retrieved water from a rock: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲡⲉⲧⲣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲕⲟϩ ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲧ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fe-etaf eni en-ou-mow-ou, evol khen ou-petra enkoh enshowt, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: To Him who struck down great kings: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϣⲁⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲁⲛⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fe-etaf shari ehan-neshti en-owro-ou, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: And slew famous kings: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϧⲱⲧⲉⲃ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲟⲩⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣⲓ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Owoh af-khowteb enhan-owroou evoi enish-firi, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: Sihon the king of the Amorites: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲏⲱⲛ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲙⲟⲣⲣⲉⲟⲥ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Seyon epouro ente ni-Amourreos, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: And Og the king of Bashan: Alleluia, His merey endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲱⲅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲑ̀Ⲃⲁⲥⲁⲛ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Nem Owg epouro ente Ethvasan, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: And gave their land as a heritage: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲁϥϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲉⲩⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Afti empou-kahi, evik-lironomeia, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: A heritage to Israel His servant: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲉⲩⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲃⲱⲕ Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Ev-ek-lironomia empef-vowk pis-rael, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: The Lord who remembered us in our lowly state: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Enihri khen pen-theveio afer pen-meve-e enje Epshois, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: And rescued us from the hands of our enemies: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲥⲟⲧⲧⲉⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛϫⲓϫ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛϫⲁϫⲓ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Owoh afsotten evol khen nen jig ente nengaji, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: Who gives food to all flesh: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉⲧϯ ϧ̀ⲣⲉ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Feiet-ti ekhri ensareks niven etonkh, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: O give thanks to the God of heaven: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Ou-ownh evol Emif-nouti ente etve, Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords for He is good and virtuous: Alleluia, His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϭⲟⲓⲥ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲣⲏⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲡⲉ: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Ou-ownh evol Emip-shois ente ni-shois je o-ekhristos ou-aghathos pe Alleluia. Je pefnai shop sha eneh.

texts.en: Watch over us: from on high where you dwell: O Lady of us all: the ever-virgin Theotokos.
texts.cop: Ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲥⲟⲙⲥ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲁ ⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲣⲉⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ: ⲱ̀ ⲧⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ: ⲉⲧⲟⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Shopi entho ere soms egon, khen ni mat-shosi etar kin-kheeto, o ten-shois eneeb ti-ren ti-theotokos, etoy em-parthenos enseyo niven.

texts.en: Ask of Him whom you have borne: our good Savior: to take away our troubles: and grant us His peace.
texts.cop: Ⲙⲁϯϩⲟ ⲙ̀ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲣⲉⲙⲁⲥϥ: ⲡⲉⲛⲤⲱⲧⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲱ̀ⲗⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓϧⲓⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϩⲁⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲉⲙⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ.
texts.cop_en: Ma-tiho emfi et-remasf, pensoteer en aghathos, entef oli enay-khisi evol haron, entef semni-nan entef hir-ini.

texts.en: Hail to you, O Virgin, / the right and true Queen. / Hail to the pride of our race / who bore to us Immanuel.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲠⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Shere ne oti-parthenos, ti-oro emmi en alitheeni, shere epsho-sho ente pengenos, ari egfo nan en Emmanoeel.

texts.en: We ask you to remember us, / O our faithful advocate, / before our Lord Jesus Christ / that He may forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Ten-tiho ari-pen-mevi, oti-epros-tatis etenhot, nahren penshois Esos Pekhrestos, entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

texts.en: In Christ Jesus our Lord.
texts.cop: Ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛϭⲟⲓⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Khen pi-ekhristos Esos Penchoise.

texts.en: Bow your heads to the Lord.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲁⲥ ⲕⲉⲫⲁⲗⲁⲥ ⲩ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲧⲱ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲱ ⲕ̀ⲗⲓⲛⲁⲧⲉ.
texts.cop_en: Tas ke-falas Emmon To Kerio eklinate.

texts.en: Before You, O Lord
texts.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲛⲱⲡⲓⲟⲛ ⲥⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ.
texts.cop_en: Enopion so Kerie.

texts.en: Let us attend in the fear of God. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲭⲱⲙⲉⲛ Ⲑⲉⲟⲩ ⲙⲉⲧⲁ ⲫⲟⲃⲟⲩ. Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Pros-khomen theo meta fovo. Amen.

texts.en: And with your spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲥⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Ke to epnevmati so.

texts.en: Saved. Amen. And with your spirit. In the fear of God, let us attend.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲱⲑⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲥⲟⲩ: ⲙⲉⲧⲁ ⲫⲟⲃⲟⲩ Ⲑⲉⲟⲩ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲭⲱⲙⲉⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Sotees amen. Ke to epnevmati so. meta fovo theo Pros-khomen.

texts.en: Amen. Lord have mercy, Lord have mercy, Lord have mercy.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Amen. Kerie eleyson, Kerie eleyson, Kerie eleyson.

texts.en: One is the All-Holy Father, one is the All-Holy Son, one is the All-Holy Spirit. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲓⲥ ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲛⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ: ⲓⲥ ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲛⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲩⲓⲟⲥ: ⲉⲛ ⲧⲟ ⲡⲁⲛⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲛ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ: ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ees O panagios Pateer, Ees O panagios Eyos, en to panagion epnevma. Amen.

texts.en: Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Amen.

texts.en: Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Amen.

texts.en: Amen, I believe.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ. Ϯⲛⲁϩϯ.
texts.cop_en: Amen. Tee-nah-tee.

hymns.title: The Paralax Hymn Our Lord (Nativity - Coptic)

texts.en: Our Lord Jesus Christ, who was born of the Virgin, in Bethlehem of Judea, according to the prophetic voices.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥ ⲙⲁⲥϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϯⲠⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲒⲟⲩⲇⲉⲁ̀: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ
texts.cop_en: Apen-shois Esos Pi-ekhrestos fee-etas masf enje ti-parthe-nos, khen Veth-leem ente ti-Iouze-a, kata ni-esmee emip-ro-phi-tikon.

texts.en: The Cherubim and the Seraphim, the angels and the archangels, the principalities and the authorities, the thrones, the dominions, and the powers.
texts.cop: ⲚⲓⲬⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲤⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ: ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲣⲁⲧⲓⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲝⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ: ⲛⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲧⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲙ.
texts.cop_en: Ni-She-robim nem ni-Seraphim, ni-angelos nem ni-arshi-angelos, ni-sete-rateia nem ni-e-exso-seia, ni-eth-ronos ni-met chois ni-gom.

texts.en: Proclaiming and saying, "Glory to God in the highest, peace on earth, and good will toward men."
texts.cop: Ⲉⲩⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲩϫⲟ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲟ̀ⲩⲱ̀ⲟ̀ⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϯⲙⲁϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Evhos evol evgo emmos je oo-o-oo Emif-nouti khenni-etit-shoisee, nem oo-heri-ni hejen pi-kahee, nem oo-ti-mati khenni-roumi.

texts.en: Saved Amen, and with your spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲱⲑⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲥⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: So-tees ameen, ke to epnev-ma-ti so.

texts.en: His foundation are in the holy mountains. The Lord loves the gates of Zion, more than all the tents of Jacob. Glorious things have been spoken of you, O city of God. Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲛⲉϥⲥⲉⲛϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ. Ⲁ̀ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲙⲉⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ: ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃ. Ⲁϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲏϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲛ̀ⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲩⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ: ϯⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ. Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Nefsin-ti khenne-to-o ethowab, a-epshois mey eni-pilee ente Seion, eho-tene-ma enshopi tero ente Yakop, afsaje ethveti enhan ehve-owee ev-taiot, ti-vaki ente Efnouti. Alleloia.

texts.en: Mother Zion will say, “A man and a man dwells in her,” and the Most High cast her foundation. Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ ϯⲙⲁⲩ ⲛⲁϫⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ Ⲡⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲁϥϩⲓⲥⲉⲛϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ. Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Seion ti-mav nagos, je o-romi nem o-romi af-shobi enkhets, owoh enthof p-etit-shosee, afhe-senti emmos sha eneh, alleloia.

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: O King of peace, give us Your peace, grant us Your peace, and forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Epouro enteti hirini / moynan entek hirini / semni nan entek hirini / kanen novi nan evol.

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: Disperse the enemies, of the Church, and fortify her, that she may never weaken.
texts.cop: Ϫⲱⲣ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϫⲁϫⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ̀: ⲁⲣⲓⲥⲟⲃⲧ ⲉⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲕⲓⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: gorh evol enni gaji / enteti ekekleseya / ari soft eros / enneskem sha-eneh.

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: Emmanuel our God, is now in our midst, with the glory of His Father, and the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ : ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲙⲏϯ ϯⲛⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡ̅ⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
texts.cop_en: emmanoeel pennoti / khen tenmeeti tino / khen ep-oo ente peviot / nem pi epnevma ethowab.

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: May He bless us all, and purify our hearts, and heal the sicknesses, of our souls and bodies.
texts.cop: Ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲟⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲁⲗϭⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϣⲱⲛⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲥⲱⲙⲁ.
texts.cop_en: entefesmo eron tiren / entef tovo ennen heet / entev talet sho enni sho ni / ente nen epsishi nem nen soma.

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: Lord have mercy. [3 times]
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ. (3 times)
texts.cop_en: Kerie Eleyson. (3 times)

texts.en: We worship You O Christ, with Your Good Father, and the Holy Spirit, for You were crucified and saved us.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡ̅ⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲁϣⲕ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: tenoo-osht emmok o pi ekhrestos / nem pekyot en aghathos / nem pi epnevma ethowab / je ak ashk aksoti Emmon.

texts.en: Alleluia, alleluia. Jesus Christ the King of glory, rose from the dead on the third day. Alleluia, alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅. Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁϩϣⲟⲙⲧ. Ⲁ̅ⲗ̅ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅.
texts.cop_en: Alleloia alleloia, Esos Pikhrestos ep-oro ente ep-o-oo, aftonf evol khennieth-mo-oot khenpi-eho-oo emmah-shomt, alleloia alleloia.

texts.en: Then He was placed in the tomb, according to the prophetic voices, on the third day, Christ is risen from the dead.
texts.cop: Ⲗⲟⲓⲡⲟⲛ ⲁⲩⲭⲁϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙ̀ϩⲁⲩ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩϣⲟⲙⲧ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ: Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲧⲏ ⲉⲕ ⲛⲉⲕⲣⲱⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Lebon av-qav khen pi-emhav, kata ni-esmi emep-rofe-tikon, khen be-mah shomte-en-eho-oo, Pikh-restos anisti ek-nekron.

texts.en: Alleluia (4), Jesus Christ the King of glory, rose from the dead.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ (ⲇ̅): Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia Alleluia, Alleluia Alleluia, Esos Pekhrestos eporo ente epoo, aftonf evol khen ni-ethmo-ot.

texts.en: This is He to whom is due glory, with His good Father, and the Holy Spirit, both now and forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟ̀ⲩ ⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲓⲛⲁϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fay ere pi oo erep reby naf, nem pek yot enaghathos, nem pi epnevma ethowab, yes gen tee no nem sha eneh.

texts.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, the perfect Trinity. We worship Him and glorify Him.
texts.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϯⲦ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Jefes maroout, En jefyot nem Epshiri, Nem pi Epnevma Ethowab, Tietrias etjeek evol, Ten Oosht Emmos Tentiou Nas

texts.en: Through the intercessions, of the holy archangel, Gabriel the herald of glad tidings, O Lord grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓϥⲁⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten niepresvia, ente pi-arshiangelos ethowab, Ghabrieel pi-fai-shen-nofi, epchoise ari-ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen-novi.

texts.en: Through the intercessions, of the kinsman of Emmanuel, John the son of Zacharias, O Lord grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲥⲩⲅⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: Ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲍⲁⲭⲁⲣⲓⲁⲥ: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten niepresvia, ente pi-sengenees en-emmanoeel, Yoannees epshiri en-zakharias, epchoise ari-ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen-novi.

texts.en: Through the prayers, of the priest Zacharias, and his wife Elizabeth, O Lord grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ Ⲍⲁⲭⲁⲣⲓⲁⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧⲉϥⲥ̀ϩⲓⲙⲓ Ⲉ̀ⲗⲓⲥⲁⲃⲉⲧ: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni-evkee, ente pioweeb Zakharias, nem tefeshimi Elesabet, epchoise ari-ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen-novi.

texts.en: Through the prayers, of the blessed elders, Joachim and Anna, O Lord grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϧⲉⲗⲗⲟⲓ ⲧ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ: Ⲓⲱⲁ̀ⲕⲓⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲛⲛⲁ: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni-evkee, ente ni-khelooi etesmaroot, Yowakim nem Anna, epchoise ari-ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen-novi.

texts.en: Amen. Alleluia: Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit: now and ever and unto the ages of the ages: Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ: ⲁ̅ⲗ̅ ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ ⲁⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ: ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Amin Alleluia. Doxa patri ke Eio ke Agio Epnevmati, ke nin ke a-ee ke ees toos e onas ton e onon Amin.

texts.en: We proclaim and say, "O our Lord Jesus Christ,
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅:
texts.cop_en: Ten osh evol engo emmos: Je O pen Choic Isos Piekhristos.

texts.en: the Begotten of the Father before all the ages,
texts.cop: Ⲡⲓⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ϧⲁϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ:
texts.cop_en: Pimisi evol khen efiout khago-oo enieoon teero.

texts.en: save us and have mercy on us."
texts.cop: ⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Soti emmon owoh nai nan:

texts.en: Lord have mercy: Lord have mercy: Lord bless us: Amen: Bless me: Bless me: Lo, the mentania: Forgive me: Say the blessing.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲏⲥⲟⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲓ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲓ: ⲓⲥ ϯⲙⲉⲧⲁⲛⲟⲓⲁ̀: ⲭⲱ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Kirie eleyson. Kirie eleyson. Kirie evlogison. Amin. Esmoo eroi: Ti metanoia Ko nee evol Go em pi esmoo.

texts.en: Then our mouths are filled with joy, and oun tongues with rejoicing, for our Lord Jesus Christ, is risen from the dead.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲣⲱⲛ ⲁϥⲙⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉⲛⲗⲁⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Tote ron afmoh enrashi: owoh penlas khen oo-theleel:m je Penchois IsosPi-ekhristos: aftonf evol khen nee-ethmo-oot.

texts.en: He has abolished death by His might, and made life shine upon us, He is the one who has descended, to the lower parts of the earth.
texts.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲱⲣϥ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ: ⲁϥⲑ̀ⲣⲉⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲟⲛ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ: ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲙⲁ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Afkorf em-efmo khen tefgom:af-ethre-eponkh er-oo-oini eron: enthof on fee-etaf-shenaf: eniima etsa-peseet em-epkahi.

texts.en: The gatekeepers of Hades, saw Him and were afraid, He abolished the pangs of death, for He was not held by them.
texts.cop: Ⲛⲓⲙ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲙⲉⲛϯ: ⲁⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁⲩⲉⲣϩⲟϯ: ⲁϥⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲛⲁⲕϩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩϣ̀ϫⲉⲙϫⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ.
texts.cop_en: Ni-emnot ente Amentee: avnav erof av-erhotee: aftako en-ninak-hi em-efmoo: empo-esh-gemgom en-amoni emmof.

texts.en: He has crushed the gates of brass, and broke the bars of iron, and brought out His chosen ones, with rejoicing and with joy.
texts.cop: Ⲁϥϧⲟⲙϧⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ϩⲟⲙⲧ: ⲁϥⲕⲱϣ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲙⲟⲭⲗⲟⲩⲥ ⲙ̀ⲃⲉⲛⲓⲡⲓ: ⲁϥⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Af-khom-khem enhanpilee enhomt:afkosh en-hanmokhlos emvenipi: af-ini en-nefsotp evol:khen oo-oonof nem nn-theleel.

texts.en: He lifted them up with Him, into His place of rest, and saved them for the sake of His name, and revealed His power to them.
texts.cop: Ⲁϥⲟ̀ⲗⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ: ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϥⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉⲙⲧⲟⲛ: ⲁϥⲛⲁϩⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Af-oloo e-epchisi nemaf: ekhon en-efma-enemton: afnahmo ethve pefran: afoo-onh entefgom no-oo evol.

texts.en: Therefore we are rich, with perfect good things, and in faith we sing, saying Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁⲙⲁⲟ̀: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲁϩϯ ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ: ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Ethve fai tenoi enrama-o: khen ni-aghathon etjeek evol: khen oonahtee ten-erpsalin: engo emmos je alleeloia.

texts.en: Alleluia Alleluia, Alleluia Alleluia, Jesus Christ the King of glory, is risen from the dead.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ (ⲇ̅): Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Alleeloia (4): Isos pi-ekhristos eporo ente ep-o-oo: aftonf evol khen nee-ethmo-oot.

texts.en: This is He to whom is due glory: with His good Father: and the Holy Spirit: both now and forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲓ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ Ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fai ere pi-o-oo er-eprepi naf: nem Pefiot en-aghathos nem Pi-epnevma ethowab: yesjen teeno nem sha eneh.

hymns.title: Conclusion of the Orthodox Creed (Matins/Vespers - Long)

texts.en: We look for the resurrection of the dead, and the life of the age to come. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁ ⲧ̀ϩⲏ ⲛ̀ϯⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ. Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ten gosht evol kha et hee-enti anastasis, ente-ni refmoo-oot, nem pi-onkh ente pi-eoo-oon ethneeyou. Amen.

texts.en: Have mercy upon us, O God, the Father, the Pantocrator.
texts.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ.
texts.cop_en: Eleyson eemas O theos O Pateer O Pantokrator.

texts.en: May their holy blessing be with us. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ. Ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ere poo esmoo ethowab Shopi neman Amin.

texts.en: Glory to You, O Lord. Lord have mercy. Lord have mercy. Lord, bless us. Lord, repose them. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲏⲥⲟⲛ: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲡⲁⲩⲥⲟⲛ: ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: zoxa si Kirie zoxa si Kirie Kirie Eleyson Kirie Eleyson Kirie evlogison Kirie anapavson Amin.

hymns.title: Verses of the Cymbals (Adam & Watos Intros - Coptic)

texts.en: Watos Introduction:
Lord have mercy.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Kerie eleyson.

texts.en: We worship the Father and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the holy and co-essential Trinity.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ Ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: Ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲛ̀ⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲟⲩⲥⲓⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Ten oo osht em Efiot nem epshiri: Nem Pi epnevma Ethowab: Ti Etrias Ethowab: En omo oosios.

texts.en: Hail to the Church, the house of the angels, hail to the Virgin, who gave birth to our Savior.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ϯⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲉⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ.
texts.cop_en: Shere ti ekkliseia: Epee ente ni angelos: Shere ti parthenos: Etasmes Pensoteer.

texts.en: Adam Introduction:
Lord have mercy.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Kirie Eleyson

texts.en: O come let us worship, the Holy Trinity, the Father and the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲙⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ: ⲛ̀Ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ Ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
texts.cop_en: Amoini maren oo osht: Enti etreias ethowab: Ete Efiot nem Epshiri: Nem Pi epnevma Ethowab.

texts.en: We are the Christian people, for He is our true God.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲛ ϧⲁ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲓⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲫⲁⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲡⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Anon Kha nila os: En ekhristeianos: Fay ghar pepen noti: En alithinos.

texts.en: We have hope, in Saint Mary, that God will have mercy on us, through her intercessions.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϩⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲑⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ Ⲫ̀ϯ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲥⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Oo on oo helpees entan: Khen thi ethowab Mareia: Ere efnoti nay nan: hiten nes epresvia.

texts.en: All calmness, in the world, is through the prayers, of Saint Mary the Virgin.
texts.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲧⲥⲉⲙⲛⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓϣ̀ⲗⲏⲗ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Oo on oo metsemnos: enehri khen pi-kosmos: evol hiten pieshlil: ente ti-agia Maria ti-parthenos.

hymns.title: The Vespers Doxology for the Virgin (English)

texts.en: The Adornment of Mary / in the highest heaven / at the right hand of her beloved / entreating Him on our behalf.
texts.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ⲥⲟⲗⲥⲉⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲧ̀ⲥⲁ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ: ⲉ̀ⲥⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ere epsol sel em Mariam/ khen ni fi ouwi etsa epshoi/ sa ouwi nam em pes men rit/ estovh emmof eh ehri egon

texts.en: As David has said / in the Book of Psalms, / “The Queen stood at / Your right hand,” O King.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲯ̀ⲁⲗⲟⲙⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ: ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲡ̀Ⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
texts.cop_en: Kata efriti etaf gos/ enje Davide khen pi epsalmos/ je us ohowi erats inje ti ourow/ sa ouwi nam emmok eporo

texts.en: Solomon has called her / in the Song of Songs, / “My sister and my spouse / my true city Jerusalem.”
texts.cop: Ⲥⲟⲗⲟⲙⲱⲛ ⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲣⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓϫⲱ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϫⲱ: ϫⲉ ⲧⲁⲥⲱⲛⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲁϣ̀ⲫⲉⲣⲓ: ⲧⲁⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ Ⲓⲉⲣⲟⲩⲥⲁⲗⲏⲙ.
texts.cop_en: Solomon motee eros / khen pigo ente nigo / je tasoni owoh ta ehveeri / tapolis emee Yaroosalim.

texts.en: For he has given a symbol of her / in many high names, saying / “Come out of your garden, / O choicest aroma.”
texts.cop: Ⲁϥϯⲙⲏⲓⲛⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲉⲩϭⲟⲥⲓ: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲏ̀ⲡⲟⲥ: ⲱ̀ ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲁⲧⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Afteemini ghar eros / khen hanmeesh enran ev-echosy / je amee evol khen pek-ee-pos / 0 thee etasotp en aromata

texts.en: Hail to you, O Virgin, / the right and true Queen. / Hail to the pride of our race / who bore to us Immanuel.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲠⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Shere ne o teeparthenos / tee-oro emee enaleethini / shere epsho- sho ente pengenos / ariegvo nan en-Emanoeel

texts.en: We ask you to remember us, / O our faithful advocate, / before our Lord Jesus Christ / that He may forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Tenteeho aripamevi / O tee- eprostasis entenhot / naren Penchois Isos Pekhristos / entef kha nenovi nan evol.

texts.en: Hail to you O martyr, Hail to the courageous hero, Hail to the struggle-mantled, Abba Mina of Bayat.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ̀ⲱⲡⲓⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϣⲱⲓϫ ⲛ̀ⲅⲉⲛⲛⲉⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ: ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲛⲓⲫⲁⲓⲁⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Shere nak O pi-marteros, shere pi-shoig en-genneos, shere pi-athloforos, avva Mina ente ni-Vaiat.

texts.en: Glory to You O Lord, glory to You.
texts.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Zoxa ci kirie. Zoxa ci.

texts.en: Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia

texts.en: Praise God in all His saints.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo Efnouti khen ni-ethowab tiro entaf, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him in the firmament of His power.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen pi-tagro ente tef-gom, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him for His mighty acts.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧϫⲱⲣⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof e-ehri hijen tefmet-gowri, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him according to the multitudes of His greatness.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲁ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧⲛⲓϣϯ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof kata ep-ashai ente tef-met-nishti, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲅⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen ou-esmi ensalpen-ghos, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with psaltery and harp.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲯⲁⲗⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen ou-epsal-terion nem ou-kithara, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with timbrel and chorus.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen han-kem-kem nem han-khoros, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with strings and organs.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲁⲡ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲟⲣⲅⲁⲛⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen han-kap nem ou-orghanon, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him with pleasant sounding cymbals.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲉ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen han-kim-valon ene-setou-esmi, alleluia.

texts.en: Praise Him upon the cymbals of joy.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲉ̀ϣ̀ⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓ̀.
texts.cop_en: Esmo erof khen han-valon ente ou-eshlilowi, alleluia.

texts.en: Let every thing that has breath praise the name of the Lord our God.
texts.cop: Ⲛⲓϥⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ.
texts.cop_en: Nifi niven maro-esmo tiro Ee-efran Emipshois Pennouti, alleluia.

texts.en: Glory to the Father, and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ̀ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Zoxa Patree ke Eio ke Agio Epnevmati, alleluia.

texts.en: Now and ever and unto the ages of the ages. Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ke neen ke a-ee ke estos e-onas ton e-onon amen. Alleluia.

texts.en: Alleluia, Alleluia, glory to you our God.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅: ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ ⲟ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia, alleluia, Zoxa si o Theos emon, alleluia.

texts.en: Alleluia, Alleluia, glory be to our God.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅: ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ ⲡⲉⲛⲚⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia, alleluia, pi-ow-ou fa pennouti pe, alleluia.

texts.en: O Jesus Christ, the Son of God, hear us and have mercy upon us.
texts.cop: Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Esos Pi-khristos epshiri emefnouti, sotem eron owoh nai nan.

texts.en: We send you greetings / with Gabriel the angel, / saying, “Hail to you, O full of grace, / the Lord is with you.”
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯ ⲛⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲉⲣⲉⲧⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲕⲉⲭⲁⲣⲓⲧⲱⲙⲉⲛⲏ: ⲟ̀ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁ ⲥⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Tenti nem-pi-shere tis-mos, nem Ghabriel pi-angelos, je shere ke kharito-mini, o Kerios metaso.

texts.en: Therefore we glorify you, as the Mother of God at all times. Ask the Lord on our behalf, that He may forgive us our sins!
texts.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉ: ϩⲱⲥ Ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ⲙⲁϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Ethve fai ten-ti o-oo-ne, hos theo-tokos enseio nivin, matiho e-epshois e-ehrey e-gon, entef ka nen-novi nan e-vol.

texts.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son / and the Holy Spirit / the perfect Trinity / we worship Him and glorify Him.
texts.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟ̀ⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϯⲦ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲧⲉⲛⲟ̀ⲩⲱ̀ϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟ̀ⲩ ⲛⲁⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Jefes maroout / En jefyot nem Epshiri / Nem pi Epnevma Ethowab / Tietrias etjeek evol / Ten Oosht Emmos Tentiou Nas

texts.en: We exalt you worthily, / with Elizabeth your cousin: / saying, “Blessed are you among women, / blessed is the fruit of your womb.”
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲉⲙⲡ̀ϣⲁ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲉ̀ⲗⲓⲥⲁⲃⲉⲧ ⲧⲉⲥⲩⲅⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ: ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲧⲁϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉⲛⲉϫⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Tenit-shesi emmo khen o-emipsha, nem elee-sabet te-sen-genis, je tis-maroot entho khenni-heyomi, efis-maroot enje ep-otah ente-te-neje.

texts.en: Therefore we glorify you, as the Mother of God at all times. Ask the Lord on our behalf, that He may forgive us our sins!
texts.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉ: ϩⲱⲥ Ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ⲙⲁϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Ethve fai ten-ti o-oo-ne, hos theo-tokos enseio nivin, matiho e-epshois e-ehrey e-gon, entef ka nen-novi nan e-vol.

texts.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son / and the Holy Spirit / the perfect Trinity / we worship Him and glorify Him.
texts.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟ̀ⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϯⲦ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲧⲉⲛⲟ̀ⲩⲱ̀ϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟ̀ⲩ ⲛⲁⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Jefes maroout / En jefyot nem Epshiri / Nem pi Epnevma Ethowab / Tietrias etjeek evol / Ten Oosht Emmos Tentiou Nas

texts.en: Thine is the power, the glory, the blessing, the majesty, forever Amen. Immanuel our God and our King.
texts.cop: Ⲑⲱⲕ ⲧⲉ ϯϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲙⲁϩⲓ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉⲛⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
texts.cop_en: Thok te ti-gom, nem pi-o-oo nem pi-esmo, nem pi-amahee sha eneh amen, Emmano-eel pen-nouti pen-oroo.

texts.en: Thine is the power, the glory, the blessing, the majesty, forever Amen. My Lord Jesus Christ.
texts.cop: Ⲑⲱⲕ ⲧⲉ ϯϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲙⲁϩⲓ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: Ⲡⲁⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅.
texts.cop_en: Thok te ti-gom, nem pi-o-oo nem pi-esmo, nem pi-amahee sha eneh amen, pa-Shois Esos Piekh-restos.

texts.en: Starting from the 11th hour on Tuesday, this part is added:
texts.cop: Starting from the 11th hour on Tuesday, this part is added:
texts.cop_en: Starting from the 11th hour on Tuesday, this part is added:

texts.en: My good Savior.
texts.cop: ⲡⲁⲤⲱⲧⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Pasoteer en-aghathos.

texts.en: Starting from the Eve of Friday, this part is added:
texts.cop: Starting from the Eve of Friday, this part is added:
texts.cop_en: Starting from the Eve of Friday, this part is added:

texts.en: The Lord is my strength, my praise, He has become to me a sacred salvation.
texts.cop: ⲧⲁϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲁⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅: ⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲉⲩⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲉϥⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
texts.cop_en: Ta-gom, nem pa-esmo pi-epshois af-shobi nee, af-sotereia ef-owab.

texts.en: Thine is the power, the glory, the blessing, the majesty, forever Amen.
texts.cop: Ⲑⲱⲕ ⲧⲉ ϯϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲙⲁϩⲓ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Thok te ti-gom, nem pi-o-oo nem pi-esmo, nem pi-amahee sha eneh amen.

texts.en: Alleluia. The thought of man shall confess You O Lord, and the remainder of thought shall keep a feast to You. The sacrifices and the offerings receive them to Yourself. Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ. Ϫⲉ ⲫ̀ⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ⲟ̀ⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲟ̀ⲩⲱ̀ⲛϩ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ Ⲡ̀ⲟ̅ⲥ̅: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡ̀ⲥⲱϫⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟ̀ⲩⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲉⲣϣⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲕ. Ⲛⲓⲑⲩⲥⲓⲁ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲫⲟⲣⲁ ϣⲟⲡⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ. Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia je ef-mev-ee en-oo-romi ef-e-ooonh nak evol epchois: ow-oh epsogb ente oo mevee ef-e-er-shai nak. Ni-thi-siya ni-eprosfora shopo erok. Alleluia

texts.en: This censer of pure gold bearing the aroma, is in the hands of Aaron the priest, offering up incense upon the altar.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲁⲓϣⲟⲩⲣⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲧϥⲁⲓ ϧⲁ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲁⲧⲁ: ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛϫⲓϫ ⲛ̀Ⲁ̀ⲁⲣⲱⲛ ⲡⲓⲟ̀ⲩⲏⲃ ⲉϥⲧⲁⲗⲉ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲣϣⲱⲟ̀ⲩϣⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Tay-shory ennob enka-tharos etfai kha pi-aro-mata, etkhen nen-jeeg en-A-aron pi-oweeb eftale oo-estoi-nofi e-epshoi ejen pima en-ersho-oshi.

texts.en: ... of our honored father, the archpriest, Pope Abba (...): and our father the metropolitan (bishop), Abba (...) the beloved of Christ.
texts.cop: ... ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲓⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲓⲧⲏⲥ (ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ) ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: ... Empeniot et-taiot en-arshi-erevs papa Avva (...), nem pen yoat en-e-piskopos avva (...), ni-menrati ente Pi-khrestos.

texts.en: O King of peace, give us Your peace, grant us Your peace, and forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Epouro enteti hirini / moynan entek hirini / semni nan entek hirini / kanen novi nan evol.

texts.en: Disperse the enemies, of the Church, and fortify her, that she may never weaken.
texts.cop: Ϫⲱⲣ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϫⲁϫⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ̀: ⲁⲣⲓⲥⲟⲃⲧ ⲉⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲕⲓⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: gorh evol enni gaji / enteti ekekleseya / ari soft eros / enneskem sha-eneh.

texts.en: Emmanuel our God, is now in our midst, with the glory of His Father, and the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ : ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲙⲏϯ ϯⲛⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡ̅ⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
texts.cop_en: emmanoeel pennoti / khen tenmeeti tino / khen ep-oo ente peviot / nem pi epnevma ethowab.

texts.en: May He bless us all, and purify our hearts, and heal the sicknesses, of our souls and bodies.
texts.cop: Ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲟⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲁⲗϭⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϣⲱⲛⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲥⲱⲙⲁ.
texts.cop_en: entefesmo eron tiren / entef tovo ennen heet / entev talet sho enni sho ni / ente nen epsishi nem nen soma.

texts.en: We worship You O Christ, with Your Good Father, and the Holy Spirit, for You were crucified and saved us.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡ̅ⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲁϣⲕ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: tenoo-osht emmok o pi ekhrestos / nem pekyot en aghathos / nem pi epnevma ethowab / je ak ashk aksoti Emmon.

texts.en: Saved. Amen. And with your spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲱⲑⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲥⲟⲩ
texts.cop_en: Sotees Amen. Ke to epnevmati so.

hymns.title: Watos Psali for  the three saintly children (English)

texts.en: We follow You with all our heart, and we fear You, and we seek Your face, O God do not forsake us.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲕ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲟϯ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲕϩⲏ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉⲛⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ⲡⲉⲕϩⲟ: Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣϯϣⲓⲡⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ten-oweh ensok khen penheet tirf, ten-erhoti kha-tek-hi, owoh ten-koti ensa pekho, Efnouti emper-ti-shipi nan.

texts.en: But rather deal with us, according to Your meekness, and according to Your great mercy, O Lord help us.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲏⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲁ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲁⲓ: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲃⲟⲏ̀ⲑⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Alla ari-owi neman, kata tek-met e-pi-kis, nem kata ep-ashai ente pek nai Epshoise ari-voythin eiron.

texts.en: May our prayers ascend unto You, O our Master, like burnt offerings of lambs, and fatted calves.
texts.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲧⲉⲛⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲭⲏ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲏⲃ: ⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲙ̀ⲑⲟ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛϭⲗⲓⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲱⲓⲗⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲁⲥⲓ ⲉⲩⲕⲉⲛⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Mare ten-epros-evki pennip, e-epshoi em-pek-emtho, emif-riti enhan etchlil ente han-oyli, nem hanmasi evkeni oo-ot.

texts.en: Do not forget the covenant, which You have made with our fathers, Abraham Isaac and Jacob, Israel Your holy one.
texts.cop: Ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲉⲣⲡⲱⲃϣ ⲛ̀ϯⲇⲓⲁⲑⲏⲕⲏ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ: Ⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ Ⲓ̀ⲥⲁⲁⲕ Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃ: Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲡⲉⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲕ.
texts.cop_en: Emperor ep-ovsh enti zia-thiki, thi-etak-sem-nits nem nenyoti, Abraham Isaac Jacob, pis-rael pethowab entak..

texts.en: Bless the Lord all you nations, the tribes and all kinds of tongues, praise Him and glorify Him, above all forever.
texts.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲛⲓⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛⲓⲁⲥⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲗⲁⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲙⲁⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Esmo Epshoise ni-laos tiro, niphili ni-asp-en-las, hos erof ma-o-ou naf, Ari-ho-oo chasf sha ni eneh.

texts.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf, O three saintly children, Shadrach Meshach and Abed-Nego, that He may forgive us our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓϣⲟⲙⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ: Ⲥⲉⲇⲣⲁⲕ Ⲙⲓⲥⲁⲕ Ⲁⲃⲇⲉⲛⲁⲅⲱ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Tovh Emip-shois e-ehri egon, o pi-shomt en-alo en-agios, Shedrak Misak Abde-nagho, entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

texts.en: Hail to His Resurrection, when He rose from the dead, that He may save us, from our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲧⲉϥⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Shere tef-anastasees, e-taf-tonf evol khen nee-ethmo-oot, sha-entef soty emmon, evol-khen nennovi.

texts.en: Blessed are You indeed, with Your good Father, and the Holy Spirit, for You have risen and saved us. Have mercy upon us.
texts.cop: Ⲕ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ Ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲧⲱⲛⲕ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ. Ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ek-esmaro-oot alithos, nem Pekiot en-aghathos, nem pi-Epnevma ethowab, je ak-tonk aksoti emmon.

texts.en: Remember me O my Lord, remember me O my God, remember me O my King, when You come into Your kingdom.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲁϬⲟⲓⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲁⲚⲟⲩϯ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲁⲞ̀ⲩⲣⲟ: ⲁⲕϣⲁⲛⲓ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟ̀ⲩⲣⲟ.
texts.cop_en: Ari-pamev-e o pa-Shois, ari-pamev-e o pa-Noti, ari-pamev-e o pa-Oroo, akshan-e khen tekmet-oroo.

texts.en: Blessed are You indeed, with Your good Father, and the Holy Spirit, for You have come and saved us. Have mercy upon us.
texts.cop: ̀Ⲕ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟ̀ⲩⲧ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲓ̀ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ. Ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Eksmaro-ot alethos, nem Pekiot enagha-thos, nem pi-epnevma ethowab, je akee aksoti emmon. Nai nan.

texts.en: Then our mouths are filled with joy, and our tongues with rejoicing, for our Lord Jesus Christ, is risen from the dead.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲣⲱⲛ ⲁϥⲙⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉⲛⲗⲁⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Tote ron afmoh enrashi: owoh penlas khen oo-theleel:m je Penchois IsosPi-ekhristos: aftonf evol khen nee-ethmo-oot.

texts.en: He has abolished death by His might, and made life shine upon us, He is the one who has descended, to the lower parts of the earth.
texts.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲱⲣϥ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ: ⲁϥⲑ̀ⲣⲉⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲟⲛ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ: ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲙⲁ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Afkorf em-efmo khen tefgom:af-ethre-eponkh er-oo-oini eron: enthof on fee-etaf-shenaf: eniima etsa-peseet em-epkahi.

texts.en: The gatekeepers of Hades, saw Him and were afraid, He abolished the pangs of death, for He was not held by them.
texts.cop: Ⲛⲓⲙ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲙⲉⲛϯ: ⲁⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁⲩⲉⲣϩⲟϯ: ⲁϥⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲛⲁⲕϩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩϣ̀ϫⲉⲙϫⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ.
texts.cop_en: Ni-emnot ente Amentee: avnav erof av-erhotee: aftako en-ninak-hi em-efmoo: empo-esh-gemgom en-amoni emmof.

texts.en: He has crushed the gates of brass, and broke the bars of iron, and brought out His chosen ones, with rejoicing and with joy.
texts.cop: Ⲁϥϧⲟⲙϧⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ϩⲟⲙⲧ: ⲁϥⲕⲱϣ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲙⲟⲭⲗⲟⲩⲥ ⲙ̀ⲃⲉⲛⲓⲡⲓ: ⲁϥⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Af-khom-khem enhanpilee enhomt:afkosh en-hanmokhlos emvenipi: af-ini en-nefsotp evol:khen oo-oonof nem nn-theleel.

texts.en: He lifted them up with Him, into His place of rest, and saved them for the sake of His name, and revealed His power to them.
texts.cop: Ⲁϥⲟ̀ⲗⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ: ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϥⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉⲙⲧⲟⲛ: ⲁϥⲛⲁϩⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Af-oloo e-epchisi nemaf: ekhon en-efma-enemton: afnahmo ethve pefran: afoo-onh entefgom no-oo evol.

texts.en: Therefore we are rich, with perfect good things, and in faith we sing, saying Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁⲙⲁⲟ̀: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲁϩϯ ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ: ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Ethve fai tenoi enrama-o: khen ni-aghathon etjeek evol: khen oonahtee ten-erpsalin: engo emmos je alleeloia.

texts.en: Alleluia Alleluia, Alleluia Alleluia, Jesus Christ the King of glory, is risen from the dead.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ (ⲇ̅): Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Alleeloia (4): Isos pi-ekhristos eporo ente ep-o-oo: aftonf evol khen nee-ethmo-oot.

texts.en: This is He to whom is due glory: with His good Father: and the Holy Spirit: both now and forever.
texts.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲓ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ Ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Fai ere pi-o-oo er-eprepi naf: nem Pefiot en-aghathos nem Pi-epnevma ethowab: yesjen teeno nem sha eneh.

hymns.title: The Paralax Hymn Our Lord (Nativity - Coptic)

texts.en: Our Lord Jesus Christ, who was born of the Virgin, in Bethlehem of Judea, according to the prophetic voices.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥ ⲙⲁⲥϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϯⲠⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲒⲟⲩⲇⲉⲁ̀: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ
texts.cop_en: Apen-shois Esos Pi-ekhrestos fee-etas masf enje ti-parthe-nos, khen Veth-leem ente ti-Iouze-a, kata ni-esmee emip-ro-phi-tikon.

texts.en: The Cherubim and the Seraphim, the angels and the archangels, the principalities and the authorities, the thrones, the dominions, and the powers.
texts.cop: ⲚⲓⲬⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲤⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ: ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲣⲁⲧⲓⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲝⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ: ⲛⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲧⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲙ.
texts.cop_en: Ni-She-robim nem ni-Seraphim, ni-angelos nem ni-arshi-angelos, ni-sete-rateia nem ni-e-exso-seia, ni-eth-ronos ni-met chois ni-gom.

texts.en: Proclaiming and saying, "Glory to God in the highest, peace on earth, and good will toward men."
texts.cop: Ⲉⲩⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲩϫⲟ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲟ̀ⲩⲱ̀ⲟ̀ⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϯⲙⲁϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Evhos evol evgo emmos je oo-o-oo Emif-nouti khenni-etit-shoisee, nem oo-heri-ni hejen pi-kahee, nem oo-ti-mati khenni-roumi.

texts.en: Today, the virgin gives birth to the Transcendent One, and the earth offers a cave to the Unapproachable One.
texts.cop: Ⲏ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲥⲏⲙⲉⲣⲟⲛ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲩ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲟⲩⲥⲓⲟⲛ ⲧⲓⲕⲧⲓ: ⲕⲉ ⲏⲅⲏⲧⲟ ⲥⲡⲏⲗⲉⲟⲛ ⲧⲱ ⲁⲡⲣⲟⲥⲓⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲁⲅⲓ:
texts.cop_en: E-parthenos see-meron ton e-perro-seyon tektee, ke ee-gee-to espe-leon to a-pro-seeto epro-sagi

texts.en: Angels, along with shepherds glorify Him. The wise men journey with a star. Since for our sake the Eternal God was born as a Little Child.
texts.cop: ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓ ⲙⲉⲧⲁ ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲱⲛ ⲇⲟⲝⲟⲗⲟⲅⲟⲩⲥⲓ: ⲙⲁⲅⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲙⲉⲧⲁ ⲁⲥⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ⲇⲓⲡⲟⲣⲟⲩⲥⲓ: ⲇⲓ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉⲅⲉⲛⲛⲏⲑⲏ: ⲡⲉⲇⲓⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲟⲛ: ⲟ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲉⲱⲛⲱⲛ ⲑⲉⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: angeli meta pi-menon zoxo-loghosi, magi ze meta asteros ozi poro-see deemas ghar e-genee-thee peze-on neon o epro enon theos.

texts.en: Saved Amen, and with your spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲱⲑⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲥⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: So-tees ameen, ke to epnev-ma-ti so.

texts.en: His foundation are in the holy mountains. The Lord loves the gates of Zion, more than all the tents of Jacob. Glorious things have been spoken of you, O city of God. Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲛⲉϥⲥⲉⲛϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ. Ⲁ̀ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲙⲉⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ: ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃ. Ⲁϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲏϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲛ̀ⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲩⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ: ϯⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ. Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Nefsin-ti khenne-to-o ethowab, a-epshois mey eni-pilee ente Seion, eho-tene-ma enshopi tero ente Yakop, afsaje ethveti enhan ehve-owee ev-taiot, ti-vaki ente Efnouti. Alleloia.

texts.en: Mother Zion will say, “A man and a man dwelt in her." And the Most High cast her foundation. Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ ϯⲙⲁⲩ ⲛⲁϫⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ Ⲡⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲁϥϩⲓⲥⲉⲛϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ. Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Seion ti-mav nagos, je o-romi nem o-romi af-shobi enkhets, owoh enthof p-etit-shosee, afhe-senti emmos sha eneh, alleloia.

texts.en: Alleluia.
texts.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
texts.cop_en: Alleluia.

texts.en: The Bread of Life, who came down for us from heaven, has given life to the world.
texts.cop: Ⲡⲓⲱⲓⲕ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ: ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲁⲫϯ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Pioik ente eponkh, etaf ee eeseet, nan evolkhen etfe afti emeponkh empi kosmos

texts.en: And you too, O Mary, have borne in your womb the rational Manna, which came from the Father.
texts.cop: Ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ϩⲱⲓ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϥⲁⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲉϫⲓ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲘⲁⲛⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟ ⲏ̀ⲧⲟⲛ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Entho hoy Maria, arefai khen teneij, empi Manna ennoyton, rtaf-ee evol khen Efyote

texts.en: You have brought Him forth without blemish; He gave us His Body and His precious Blood, and we live forever.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲙⲁⲥϥ ⲁϭⲛⲉ ⲑⲱⲗⲉⲃ: ⲁϥϯ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲥⲱⲙⲁ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲥ̀ⲛⲟϥ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ: ⲁⲛⲱⲛϧ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Aremasf achne tholeb, afti nan empef Soma, nem pefesnof attai You, anonk sha eneh

texts.en: Around You stand the cherubim and the seraphim, and they cannot look at You.
texts.cop: Ⲥⲉⲧⲱⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ ϩⲁⲣⲟⲕ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲬⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲤⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ: ⲥⲉϣ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ ⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Setoounou harok, enje ni Cherubim, nem ni Seraphim, se-eshnav erok an

texts.en: We behold You upon the altar, and we partake of Your Body and Your precious Blood.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲛ̀ⲉⲣϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ: ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕ ⲥ̀ⲛⲟϥ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ.
texts.cop_en: Tennav erok emmini, hijen pima ener shooshi, tenchi evol khen pek Soma, nem pekesnof attai Yout

texts.en: Therefore we exalt you befittingly, with prophetic hymnology.
texts.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ: ⲙ̀ⲙⲟ ⲁ̀ⲝⲓⲱⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲩ̀ⲙⲛⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲁ̀: ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Ethve fai tenchisi, emmo axios, khen hanimnologia, emprofitikon

texts.en: For they spoke of you with great honor, O Holy City of the great King.
texts.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲏϯ: ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛ ϩ̀ⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲩⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ϯⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀Ⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
texts.cop_en: Je avsaji ethveeti enhanehviouwy ettai Yout, tivaki ethowab ente pinishti enouro

texts.en: We entreat and pray that we may win mercy, through your intercessions with the Lover of Mankind.
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲧⲉⲛⲧⲱⲃϩ: ⲉ̀ⲑⲣⲉⲛϣⲁϣⲛⲓ ⲉⲩⲛⲁⲓ: ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲩⲓⲁ̀: ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Tentiho tentovh, ethren shashni evnai, Hiten nipresvia entof empimyromi.

texts.en: Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Saint Mary, O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲩⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: Ⲡ̀ⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni-epresvia, ente tee-theotokos ethowab Maria, Epchoise ari-ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen-novi.

texts.en: Through the intercessions of the holy archangels Michael and Gabriel, O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
texts.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲩⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲛⲉⲛ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ: Ⲡ̀ⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: Hiten ni-epresvia, ente ni-arshiangelos ethowab Mikhail nem Ghabrieel, Epchoise ari-ehmot nan empiko evol ente nen-novi.

texts.en: (The Lord is with you).
texts.cop: (Ⲟ̀ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩ).
texts.cop_en: (O Kirios metasou)

texts.en: Holy is the Father the king / who observes our humility / the essence of glory; / and the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ Ⲃⲁⲥⲓⲗⲉⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ: ⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲇⲟⲝⲓⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Agios istin: opateer vasilevsin: thea-pen-thevio: genos enzoxin: to epnevma to agio.

texts.en: Righteous is the Father. / Our supporter in all our weaknesses / for the sake of the heavenly life; / and the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲃⲟⲏ̀ⲑⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ: ⲍⲱⲏⲛ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Zee-keos istin: opateer e-o-voyetheen: thea-penthevio: zoeen en-eporanion: to epnevma to agio.

texts.en: Praise belongs to the Father. / The treasury of our humility / Jesus the heavenly; / and the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲏ̀ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ Ⲑⲩⲥⲁⲩⲣⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ: Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Ee-panos istin: opateer thea-savrin: thea-penthevio: ieesos en-eporanion: to epnevma to agio.

texts.en: The Lord is the Father. / He who speaks in Truth / who took the form of our humility; / and the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲗⲁⲗⲉⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ: ⲙⲁⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Kee-rios istin: opateer la-levsin: thea-penthevio: matos en-eporanion: to epnevma to agio.

texts.en: Honored is the Father. / He who rejoices in our humility / the true, the heavenly / and the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲛⲓⲙⲓⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲝⲁⲗⲉⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ: ⲟⲛⲧⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Nee-mios istin: opateer exa-levsin: thea-penthevio: ondos en-eporanion: to epnevma to agio.

texts.en: The shepherd is the Father. / He who speaks for the sake / of our tribulations, the heavenly Cross; / in the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲣⲁⲣⲁⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ: Ⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Pee-menos istin: opateer raravsin: thea-penthevio: estavros en-eporanion: to epnevma to agio.

texts.en: Honored is the Father. / He who shines over our tribulations / with heavenly light; / and the Holy Spirit
texts.cop: Ⲧⲓⲙⲓⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲩ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲫⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ: ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Tee-mios istin: opateer emonfin: thea-penthevio: vosteer en-eporanion: to epnevma to agio.

texts.en: Hail to He who is of the Father / who rejoices in our humility / the heavenly truth indeed; / and the Holy Spirit.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲯⲁⲗⲉⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ: ⲱ̀ⲛ̀ⲧⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Shere istin istin: opateer epsalevsin: thea-penthevio: o-entos en-eporanion: to epnevma to agio.

texts.en: Hail to Bethlehem, the city of the prophets, in which Christ was born, the second Adam.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ: ⲧ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲙⲉⲥ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲁⲇⲁⲙ.
texts.cop_en: Shere Veth-le-em, etpolis enni-epro-feetees, the-etav-mes Pikhrestos en-khets, pi-mah esnav en-Adam.

texts.en: Blessed are You indeed, with Your good Father and the Holy Spirit, for You were born and saved us. Have mercy on us.
texts.cop: Ⲕ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟ̀ⲩⲧ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥⲕ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ. Ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Eksmaro-ot alethos, nem Pekiot enagha-thos, nem Pi-epnevma ethowab, ge avmask aksoti emmon. Nai nan.

texts.en: Hail to Gabriel, the great archangel, hail to him who announced glad tidings, to the Virgin Mary.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ: ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϩⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ: ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Shere Ghabriel, pi-nishti en-arshe angelos, shere fee-etaf-he-shennofi, em-Maria ti-parthenos.

texts.en: Hail to my lords and fathers, the Apostles, hail to the disciples, of our Lord Jesus Christ.
texts.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ: ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅.
texts.cop_en: Shere na-shois en-ioti, en-apos-tolos, shere ni-math-tees, ente pen-shois Esos Pekhrestos.

texts.en: Remember me O my Lord, remember me O my God, remember me O my King, when You come into Your kingdom.
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲁϬⲟⲓⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲁⲚⲟⲩϯ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲁⲞ̀ⲩⲣⲟ: ⲁⲕϣⲁⲛⲓ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟ̀ⲩⲣⲟ.
texts.cop_en: Ari-pamev-e o pa-Shois, ari-pamev-e o pa-Noti, ari-pamev-e o pa-Oroo, akshan-e khen tekmet-oroo.

texts.en: Blessed are You indeed, with Your good Father, and the Holy Spirit, for You have come and saved us. Have mercy upon us.
texts.cop: ̀Ⲕ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟ̀ⲩⲧ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲓ̀ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ. Ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
texts.cop_en: Eksmaro-ot alethos, nem Pekiot enagha-thos, nem pi-epnevma ethowab, je akee aksoti emmon. Nai nan.

texts.en: All you heavenly orders, sing to our God with the melody of praise. Rejoice with us today with gladness, in the Resurrection of the Lord Christ.
texts.cop_en: Ya kol al sofoof al sama-eyeen, ratelo le-eelahena be naghamat el-tasbeeh, wabe-tahegoo ma'na al-yowma fareheen, be-keyamat El-Sayed El-Maseeh.

texts.en: Today the prophecies are fulfilled and the sayings of the forefathers are realized by the Resurrection of the Lord from among the dead; He is the firstfruit of those who have fallen asleep.
texts.cop_en: Al-yowma qud kamalat el-nobowat, wa qud tamat akwalol-aba'a el-awaleen, be qeyamat El-Rabe men baynel-amwat, wa howa badol mod-tuge'een.

texts.en: The Lord arose as one who sleeps, and as one who is sated with wine, He has granted us the everlasting joy, and freed us from bitter bondage.
texts.cop_en: Qud kamal-Rabo methlol-na-em, wa kal sa-mely men al-khamra, wa wahabana al-na-'eem el-da-em, wa 'atukna men al-‘obodeyatel-mora.

texts.en: He led Hades captive and crushed the brass doors. He utterly broke the bars of iron and, for us, exchanged punishment for salvation.
texts.cop_en: Wa sabal-gahima sabian, wa hatama abwa-bahol-nohas, wa qassar mataresahol-hadida kasran, wa abdala lanal-'oqobata bel-khalas.

texts.en: And brought back Adam to Paradise, with joy, gladness, and happiness; he and his sons who were in captivity, to the joy once more.
texts.cop_en: Wa a'ada Adam elal-ferdos, be-farahen wa bahga wa mascara, howa wa banehe alzeena kano fel-hobos, mahalel na'em dof'a okhra.

texts.en: Today the flags of salvation spread, the bodies and the spirits were renewed, and the believers won the clemency for retribution, and glorified God with praises and joy.
texts.cop_en: Alyawman-tasharat a'lamol khalas, wa tagadadat al-ag-sam wal-arwah, wafazal-moo-menona bel-safhee 'an el-qasas, wa magdo Allahe be-tasabehe wal-afrah.

texts.en: Today the daughter of David rejoiced, and the hearts of the righteous apostles became glad, when they announced to them the news, and what they heard from the pure angels.
texts.cop_en: Alyawmab-tahagat ebnat Dawood, wa tahal-lalat qolobol-rosolel-ubrar, henama basharata-hom el-neswa be-tamam el-maw'ood, wa ma same'oho minal-mala-e-katel-ut-haar.

texts.en: That Jesus Christ is risen, “But He is not here as you see.” So the women went to His honored disciples and announced to them, the Resurrection of the Creator of all things.
texts.cop_en: Enna Yaso'al Masseha qud qam, laysa howa ha-hona kama taran, faza-habat el-neswa wa basharat-talamezahol-keram, be-qeiamat khaleq el-baraiah ag-ma'en.

texts.en: And He appeared to His disciples and gave them joy, with delight they saw Him, in the glory of His divinity and they became happy, when they saw Him alive.
texts.cop_en: Wa zahar le-talamezaho wa-ab-hagahom, be-bahaa nazaroho motagal-leian, be-magde laho-taho wa af-rahom, lamma shaha-doho hayyan.

texts.en: We praise and increase His exaltation, and confess the glory of His Resurrection, we thank Him for His great grace, for His mercy endures forever.
texts.cop_en: Nosabeha-ho wa nozed ref-'ataho, wa na'-taref be-magde qeya-matehe, wa nash-koroho 'ala 'azeme ne'-matehe, le-an elal-abadee rah-matehe.

texts.en: Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord; again in the name of the Lord.
texts.cop: Ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲓⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ ⲉⲣⲭⲟⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲉⲛ ⲟ̀ⲛⲟⲙⲁⲧⲓ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲩ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉⲛ ⲟ̀ⲛⲟⲙⲁⲧⲓ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲩ.
texts.cop_en: Evlogi-menos, o erkho-menos en onomati kereio, palin en onomati kereio.

texts.en: Hosanna to the Son of David; again to the Son of David.
texts.cop: Ⲱ̀ⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ ⲧⲱ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲧⲱ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ.
texts.cop_en: O-sana to eio Daveed, palin to eio Daveed.

texts.en: Hosanna in the highest; again in the highest.
texts.cop: Ⲱ̀ⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ ⲉⲛ ⲧⲓⲥ ⲩⲯⲓⲥⲧⲓⲥ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉⲛ ⲧⲓⲥ ⲩⲯⲓⲥⲧⲓⲥ.
texts.cop_en: O-sana en tees ep-sistes, palin en tees ep-sistes.

texts.en: Hosanna to the King of Israel; again to the King of Israel.
texts.cop: Ⲱ̀ⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ Ⲃⲁⲥⲓⲗⲓ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ Ⲃⲁⲥⲓⲗⲓ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ.
texts.cop_en: O-sana va-sili too Esraeel, palin va-sili too Esraeel

texts.en: Let us chant saying: Alleluia (3).
texts.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ⲁ̅ⲗ̅ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅.
texts.cop_en: Ten-erep-salin engo emmos: Alleloia (x3)

texts.en: Glory be to our God; again glory be to our God.
texts.cop: Ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ.
texts.cop_en: Pi-o-oo fa Pen-noti pe, palin pi-o-oo fa Pen-noti pe.

hymns.title: The Paralax Hymn Our Lord (Great Lent - Coptic)

texts.en: Our Lord Jesus Christ, fasted for us, forty days and forty nights, to save us from our sins.
texts.cop: Ⲁ ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲉⲣⲛⲏⲥⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟ̀ⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲣϩ: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲥⲱⲧⲧⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
texts.cop_en: A penshois Esos Pekhrestos, ernis-teven e-ehree e-goon, enehme enho-o nem ehme en-e-gorh, sha entef sotten khen nen-novi.

texts.en: And we too let us fast, with purity and righteousness, and let us pray, proclaiming and saying:
texts.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲱⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛ ⲉⲣⲛⲏⲥⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟ̀ⲩⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟ̀ⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲉ̀ⲣ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲉⲥⲑⲉ: ⲉⲛⲱ̀ϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
texts.cop_en: Anon hon maren ernestevin, khen o-tovo nem o-methme, owoh enten er-epros-evsheste, enosh evol engo emmos.

texts.en: "I have sinned I have sinned, my Lord Jesus forgive me, for there is no servant without sin, nor master without forgiveness."
texts.cop: Ⲁⲓⲉ̀ⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲁⲓⲉ̀ⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ: ⲡⲁⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ⲭⲱ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϫⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲃⲱⲕ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲧⲉ̀ⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ: ⲟ̀ⲩⲇⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ϭ̀ⲟⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲧⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
texts.cop_en: Ai-ernovi ai-ernovi, pa-Shois Esos ko ni evol, je emmon vok en-at-ernovi, o-ze-emmon echois en-atko evol.

texts.en: Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name, Thy kingdom come, for Thine is the glory forever.
texts.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲒⲱⲧ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟ̀ⲩⲓ̀: ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲥⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟ̀ⲩⲣⲟ: ϫⲉ ⲫⲱⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟ̀ⲩ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
texts.cop_en: Je peniot etkhenne fe-owi, maref tovo enje pekran, mares-e enje tekmetoro, je fok pe pi-o-oo sha-ni eneh.
